scope: A01 only; fixed T01 adopted English cohort; no minimum words or duplicate exclusions
primary: M01: mean(log1p(W_P)) in each year; equal mean of comparison years minus equal mean of baseline years
raw_comparisons: raw means, medians, quantiles and band shares retained; pooled article comparison supplementary

bootstrap.unit: single numeric author IDs sampled with replacement across all 2018-2025 years together
bootstrap.eligibility: at least 30 known authors per comparison year; known-author coverage >=90%; display all-article and known-author point estimates separately
bootstrap.p_values: not run; optional six-metric testing/adjustment not performed in A01

paragraphs.unit: saved P owner, fragments joined under the fixed segmentation rule
paragraphs.article_median: median owner word count within each article; no P => NA, zero-word P retained
paragraphs.article_equal_distribution: each article with P weight 1, divided across its owners
paragraphs.weighted_quantiles: inverse empirical CDF, min value with cumulative weight >=p*total; use same definition for pooled and article-equal; floating tolerance 1e-10 relative to total weight

long_audit.candidate_rule: top ceil(1%*articles_in_year) separately by W_P and W_S, descending words then article_id; union by article_id
long_audit.blinding: year, comparison group and article ID hidden; dates in original text retained
long_audit.scope: structure, systematic first/middle/last excerpts and code-candidate paragraphs; not full article semantic audit; no sample-based population error rate
